scope.input: The entire current Core12 candidate, preserving the complete old Array domain and all existing required ReadSpan parameter/alias/direct-call/f64-return shapes, never a narrower Source profile or selected functions.
scope.result: An opaque versioned static packet; no execution entry, interpreter, VM/AOT/Host/storage/GC ABI, kernel authority or Source reconstruction.
scope.unsupported: Reject old Core11 marker/schema/profile, packet version1 and every genuinely unsupported Core12 role, including View/Array result, external/Host/global/new control flow, unknown attributes or incorrect fixed publication/borrow/proofs. No fallback, conversion adapter, version relabeling, function/metadata dropping or scalar projection. Core12+this v2 producer+independent reader are adopted atomically; do not ship an intermediate producer-disabled state.

canonicalInput.proofs: Run full current Core12 verifier. Recompute split Array/View call roots and explicit family owner/origin/final-use rows; reject any differing supplied assertion before canonicalization. Always encode complete normalized lists including zero; no original proof-presence bits. Preserve semantic fixed-publication presence/table in full.
canonicalInput.otherAttributes: Same18 original exact attributes and fields plus mandatory publication attr (UnitAttr only on the existing permitted absence route); no unknown attrs, arbitrary passthrough or metadata laundering.
canonicalInput.identity: Validate original private function/signature/binding/site identities before encoding, without changing the original module identity. The canonical decoded model reconstructs all validated metadata/SSA and normalized proof tables. Original identity preimages unavailable in Core remain explicitly opaque provenance.

primitives.ScalarUse: u8 kind tag constant=1,floating=2,reference=3,arrayReadChecked=4,readSpanReadChecked=5; reference then Hash binding, other kinds imply exact empty binding; then Hash typeId,Range. Role-specific kinds/types and exact SSA-definition binding/anchor are independently validated.
primitives.OptionalPublication: u8 tag0 means decoded null/Core UnitAttr, allowed only complete no-View acyclic graph and omitted context; tag1 then Publication; all other tags reject. Any supplied fixed table, actual View or cycle requires1. Do not infer trust or silently drop a wider upper.
primitives.OptionalHash: u8 tag0 means decoded null/Core UnitAttr; tag1 then Hash; role ties call consumedDigest to whole publication presence and target row
primitives.OptionalInstruction: u8 tag0 means decoded null/Core empty DenseI64ArrayAttr; tag1 then u16 actual final family-use instruction/Core one-element DenseI64ArrayAttr; other tags reject, no fake entry operation
primitives.Flag8: u8 exact0/1, decoded JSON false/true and Core BoolAttr; no other numeric/string truthiness
primitives.ReturnUse: Same binary fields as ScalarUse; allowed kind tags floating=2,reference=3,arrayReadChecked=4,readSpanReadChecked=5,arrayDirectCall=6. Binding Hash only for reference; otherwise empty binding. Then exact f64 TypeId Hash and original value Range. Kind6 is return-only and cannot enter index/RHS/newLength roles.
primitives.OptionalStatementRange: u8 tag0 then no bytes: decoded null and Core absent statement_range, only a value/RHS read. u8 tag1 then Range: decoded two-number array and Core exact statement_range, only original standalone checked View read. Other tags or role mismatch reject. Range.start equals read.sourceRange.start, read.sourceRange.end<=Range.end within function; original order/complete grammar consumes it exactly once.

validation.whole: Whole single current Core12 verification before measure/encode; independent reader validates complete Core12 grammar, framing/source/identities, fixed publication presence/table/hash/coverage, owner/call-completion/lifetimes/roots/SCC before publishing immutable owned opaque model. No supplied lower/upper boolean is authority.
validation.identities: Function/signature/binding/allocation-site preimages are exactly the existing Core12 RFC8785 finite grammar, UTF16 ranges and valid UTF8 with no NFC. Current core descriptor identity formulas are authoritative. SourceHash/inputIdentity/requestId bind retained provenance; packet alone cannot recover unavailable Source text, packet/HIR hashes or Source export-AST membership.
validation.completeness: Ordered function_ids must equal all encoded function records, each exactly once, including private/unreachable/recursive functions. Exports are the exact encoded original sorted unique subset and resolve to exact whole-table name/id. A self-consistently removed unreachable private function cannot be detected against unavailable Source by a packet-only reader; producer whole-Core validation and independent whole binary gold establish preservation relative to the actual input.
validation.source: Preserve all18 old actual Core module attrs through the same original Module fields, plus the19th publication attr. The Module record has all19 old fields including function body and one new appended publication field. No old original attr or represented function/metadata is projected away.
validation.statementSSA: Same complete original dense SSA/source statement grammar as old Core, now includes required nominal View entry and exact view_alias, full View actuals, final floating/reference/read/call f64 ReturnUse. Every old op/source/identity field retained; no per-function Array-local requirement or unverified current-body specialization. Original standalone View read is a real complete source statement and result even when unused; OptionalStatementRange distinguishes that role with exact read-expression versus whole-statement anchors. Value/RHS roles require null. All14 complete real inputs were statically enumerated; two contain this standalone View read, none standalone Array read.
validation.density: Static finite length knowledge only: each fresh literal count exact, aliases share owner; all Array parameter owners stay permanently unknown and may alias every other parameter owner. Literal store permits known overwrite/exact append only; known literal resize cannot grow. Unknown index/call kills affected knowledge. All Array actual roots and aliases become unknown after any direct call, even a read-only-looking callee. Checked ops remain present regardless of any proof; no future access evaluated.
validation.roots: At every direct call compute exact live-before Array SSA and ReadSpan SSA lists, removing results then adding all actual operands; retain true live aliases independently. Add the canonical underlying Array owner register of each live local-created View to the Array list, even if that Array SSA has no other direct use. A formal View is rooted as its actual live View descriptor with indirectly retained original owner, never a fabricated Array register. Each list sorted unique; full exact record {block,instruction,array_registers,view_registers}. No physical ABI/GC execution claim.
validation.views: Build original Array canonical root map through creates/aliases/Array parameters. Formal View has symbolic owner {kind:parameter,index:original full slot} and origin {kind:parameter,index}; local checked View has owner {kind:array,register:canonical Array root register} and origin {kind:create,instruction}. All original view_alias SSA values share that family owner/origin and family final actual read/length/alias/call-use. Unused formal has no live interval; never coerce missing use to instruction0. Direct mutation needs origin-before mutation and mutation<last use; proven known-fresh overwrite/equal resize remains legal. Calls use effect-before-completion inclusive last-use semantics and validated fixed upper, not current body narrowing. At a call, fixed Published parameter structural effects are applied to mapped actual owner roots before the atomic View-actual use-completion. A View argument remains held through the call even if callee body/Derived is unread or Published.read=false. For every View family live through this call (last_use >= this call, including equality), a may-alias mapped structural owner is rejected. Distinct caller fresh owners may prove non-alias; formal Array/View owners conservatively may alias. No function specialization or global all-call rejection. Complete rows in View SSA register order: exact {view_register:i64,owner:DictionaryAttr,origin:DictionaryAttr,last_use:DenseI64ArrayAttr}. owner={kind="array",register:i64} or {kind="parameter",index:i64}; origin={kind="parameter",index:i64} or {kind="create",instruction:i64}. last_use is empty or exactly one actual final family-use instruction; empty denotes no use, not synthetic creation. Alias rows keep distinct View SSA but identical family owner/origin/last use. Compare all supplied rows before canonical normalization; no phantom entry instruction.
validation.scc: Compute direct-call closure over every complete function. Each cyclic node and its full outgoing reachable domain must contain neither Array create nor View checked-create. Acyclic incoming entry may allocate its actual before passing it to a recursive parameter-only function. Retain entry Fuel1; no blanket recursive refusal or allocation guard removal.
validation.canonical: Both complete proof lists always represented; supplied absent/[] proof presence remains nonsemantic only after exact recomputation/equality. Publication presence is different: it retains actual explicit fixed context or the existing no-View acyclic absence route, never drops an upper. Owner/origin/nullable-last-use mapping is exact; no version-relabeled model or retained legacy decoder.
validation.integers: Before every counted read/write/allocation verify count<=role cap and count<=remainingBytes/recordMinimum when applicable; avoid overflow with limit-used subtraction and division before multiplication. Use full-u32 arithmetic in wide checked host integers for static ranges and metadata; future access checks are retained, not run.
validation.publication: Decode complete fixed v4 context without changing hash domains or upper values. Match whole function IDs/signatures/full Array/View slots, View readonly W/S=false and f64 returnOrigin=null. Independently rederive v4 contract/scope/whole digests and actual direct/Derived/Effective owner flags, with Effective consuming fixed upper; reject undercoverage and use full wider upper for borrow. Presence0 only on verified complete no-View acyclic absence route. No Source/HIR preimage or source-content reconstruction claim.

Validate entire Core, measure complete packet/header/metadata, enforce output8MiB and only then publish stdout atomically. Any invalid input or budget/encoding failure emits zero packet bytes; diagnostics on stderr. Existing common fixed-width/hash primitives may be reused, no general execution launcher.

Preserve original v1/Core11 models and FIRST streams as historical; do not relabel their run credit. Oracle author must not read new implementations/output. All complete source functions/metadata retained; Source capability-only cases remain no packet/no invented Source credit.
